<break time="0.8s" /> And garden parties and lace frocks. <break time="0.8s" /> Meant nothing to him. <break time="0.8s" /> With a loud childish sob. <break time="0.8s" /> Laura said, Forgive my hat. <break time="0.8s" /> And this time. <break time="0.8s" /> Without waiting for Ems sister. <break time="0.8s" /> She found her way out of the house. <break time="0.8s" /> And past all those dark people. <break time="0.8s" /> At the corner of the lane she met Laurie. <break time="0.8s" /> Whom their anxious mother had sent to find her. <break time="0.8s" /> And as she pressed close against him. <break time="0.8s" /> He saw that she was crying. <break time="0.8s" /> When Laurie asked if it had been awful. <break time="0.8s" /> She sobbed, No, it was simply marvelous. <break time="0.8s" /> And then she stammered, Is not life. <break time="0.8s" /> But what life was she could not explain. <break time="0.8s" /> But it did not matter. <break time="0.8s" /> For Laurie quite understood. <break time="0.8s" /> And he simply answered. <break time="0.8s" /> Is it not, darling.
